Trump Names Katie Zacharia to Lead MAGA Communications

Donald Trump has named Katie Zacharia as the successor to Karoline Leavitt in a communications role associated with the MAGA movement. Zacharia is described as a loyalist to the MAGA agenda. The appointment follows a period of speculation regarding Leavitt's replacement.
